item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Roasted, lightly smoked chicken with a seasonal cabbage mix steamed in butter and thyme, new potatoes and blueberry sauce, topped with parsley. Served with classic cucumber salad. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Mexican-inspired pork tenderloin with citrus, chilli and warm spices, served with roasted sweet potatoes and topped with esquites. Served with pico de gallo and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mexican-inspired bean stew with citrus, chilli and warm spices, served with roasted sweet potatoes and topped with esquites. Served with pico de gallo and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Roast chicken in Arabic spices with bulgur and cauliflower tabbouleh, soured yoghurt and flatbread. (1+6+8+9+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pan-fried, Arabic-marinated tofu with bulgur and cauliflower tabbouleh, soured yoghurt and flatbread. (1+6+7+8+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Slow-cooked pork neck in white wine and herbs, served with potato and root vegetable mash and a rich, intense jus. Topped with pickled onion and chervil. (6+10+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Salt-baked celeriac served with potato and root vegetable mash and a delicious white wine sauce. Topped with pickled onion and chervil. (6+10+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Italian-spiced roasted chicken with creamy fregola (Sardinian pasta) with plenty of vegetables and chickpeas, topped with parmesan and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and a rocket and fennel salad tossed in lemon vinaigrette. Also available with wholegrain pasta, gluten free pasta and dairy free. (1+6+10+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Italian-spiced roasted cauliflower steak with creamy fregola (Sardinian pasta) with plenty of vegetables and chickpeas, topped with parmesan and parsley. Served with chilli sauce and a rocket and fennel salad tossed in lemon vinaigrette. Also available with wholegrain pasta, gluten free pasta, dairy free and vegan. (1+6+10+13+15)
